entity: the network of police / fire / veteran / cancer-named 527 political groups spending donations on fundraisers, not candidates
what_we_add: $193.7M across 19 groups 2014 to mid-2026, $0.36M to contributions, 58% labelled fundraising/caging, donor-overlap 15-74% with 13 look-alike FEC PACs
why: ProPublica names the same network in the same words - 527s purporting to support police, veterans, cancer patients and firefighters, spending on fundraisers - same finding, same direction; Daily Beast named a member group in 2021. Their $33M is a smaller slice, not a contradiction; our $194M / 19-group totals and donor-overlap numbers are nowhere in the sources.
